observations: Photo 0 shows a black flat-screen TV with visible cracks on the right side of the screen, especially near the top-right corner. The screen is off, reflecting some light and surroundings. The brand 'Polystar' is visible at the bottom center of the front bezel.

Photo 1 shows the back of the TV. A white label reads 'POLYSTAR 43" SMART TV LED' and includes model number 'P43S200'. Ports are visible: HDMI 1/ARC, HDMI 2, USB, AV IN, Optical Out, LAN, and Antenna. The TV is placed on a white plastic stool.
The screen cracks are clearly visible in photo 0, extending from the top-right corner downward and inward. The cracks are not superficial but appear to be deep fissures in the glass.

claims.claim: Neatly used polystar smart 43 inch tv
